text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't believe King's entering the Takarazuka Kinen, too! I'll smash her and rise to the top! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even Vodka is entering?! It's like a showdown between Princess Fighter heroines, old and new. How exhilarating! I have to claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the actors have taken the stage, and our race is about to begin! Care for a Princess☆Backbreaker?!
